school: 湛然居士之学（契丹皇族出身的儒释融合政治家，以佛家治心、儒家治国、历算医卜通草原之门，蒙古帝国制度化的总设计师）
historical_significance: 耶律楚材（1190-1244），字晋卿，号湛然居士，契丹皇族后裔（辽东丹王耶律倍八世孙），生于燕京，金朝旧臣而终为蒙元开国第一代制度家。幼习汉籍，博极群书，旁通天文、地理、律历、术数及释老医卜之说；师事万松行秀参禅三年，'忘缘息虑'，自誓不杂一言。成吉思汗取燕后召用之，以星象医卜、历算文墨随征西域十余年；1219年西征途中于寻斯干（撒马尔罕）以西域实测参订《庚申元历》。窝阔台即位后为其首席文臣，权中书省：以岁入账目驳'悉空汉地为牧场'之议，设十路课税所，定地税商税盐酒铁冶之课，使蒙古财政由劫掠转向定制；立编修所、经籍所收金朝图籍；1237年主持'戊戌选试'取士四千余人，开元代科举之基，并释放沦为驱口的儒士数千人。屡以'止杀''恤民'进言，所活生民不可胜计。窝阔台晚年信用奥都剌合蛮扑买课税，楚材力争不得；乃马真皇后称制后事多不由中书，1244年愤悒而卒，年五十五。其政虽在其身后屡遭破坏，而文书先例俱存，忽必烈朝汉法派多祖述之——他是把草原征服帝国第一次拉向常轨文治的人，'马上得之，不可马上治之'在13世纪的实践者。
historical_significance_en: Yelü Chucai (1190-1244), courtesy name Jinqing, style Juran Layman, descendant of Khitan royalty (eighth-generation heir of Yelü Bei, Prince of Dongdan), born in Yanjing, a minister of the fallen Jin who became the founding institutional architect of the Mongol empire. Raised on the Chinese classics, learned in astronomy, geography, calendrics, divination and the Buddhist and Daoist arts, he studied Chan three years under Wan-song Xingxiu, 'forgetting conditions and stilling thoughts', vowing not one idle word. Taken into Genghis Khan's service after the fall of Yanjing, he followed the western campaign over a decade as astrologer, physician and man of letters; on campaign at Samarqand he revised the Gengshen calendar against western measurements. Under Ögedei he was chief civil minister, holding the Secretariat: with a revenue account he defeated the proposal to empty the Han lands for pasture, set up the ten provincial tax commissions, fixed the land and trade taxes and the salt, wine and iron duties — turning Mongol finance from plunder to statute; founded the Institute of Compilation and Office of Classics to gather the Jin archives; directed the examination of 1237 that selected over four thousand scholars, founding the Yuan examination system, and freed thousands of scholars held as slaves. Again and again he counseled to spare the slaughter and cherish the people; history cannot count the lives saved. In Ögedei's last years the tax farmer Abd al-Rahman rose over his objections; under the regency of Empress Töregene edicts bypassed the chancellery, and in 1244 he died worn down, at fifty-five. His policies were wrecked after him, yet papers and precedents stood — Qubilai's court revived Han law by citing him: the man who first pulled a steppe conquest empire onto the track of civil rule, the 13th-century practitioner of 'won from horseback, not to be ruled from horseback'.
unique_thinking: 耶律楚材思维模式的独特性在于'把文明翻译成权力的语言，再把权力的恩典翻译成制度'的双向翻译工程：(1)财政翻译思维——不哀求不檄讨，把人口、农田、士人折算成岁入数字，让保护文明成为征服者自己算得过来的账；(2)接口思维——从对方的信任结构（星象、医卜、实效）进入，把儒家政治主张装载进大汗愿意听信的知识形式；(3)档案思维——凡争必验之于簿，以户籍文簿替代嗓门与忠诚，让写下的数字约束一时之怒；(4)定制思维——在掠夺与包税之间立定额可预期的税制，用一张税单同时给百姓生存预期与朝廷稳定岁入；(5)折叠思维——把每项口头保护即刻写成法条、置于常设机构、交给选出来的士人，使个人功业折叠进可独立运转的制度，人亡而政不自息。他证明：一个身处异族宫廷的文明护卫者，最强的武器不是道德，而是让对方无法拒绝的翻译。
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Yelü Chucai's thinking lies in a two-way translation — 'render civilization into the language of power, then render power's grace into institutions': (1) fiscal translation — no laments, no manifestos; people, fields and scholars become revenue figures, so protecting civilization becomes a ledger entry the conqueror can compute; (2) interface thinking — enter through the other's trust structure (stars, medicine, results), loading Confucian statecraft into the knowledge form the khan already believes; (3) archival thinking — every dispute checked against the registers, paper replacing voice and loyalty, the written number checking the ruler's rage; (4) statute thinking — between plunder and tax-farming, the fixed predictable rate, one tax sheet giving the people a survivable expectation and the court a steady revenue; (5) folding thinking — every orally won protection at once written into law, lodged in standing offices, handed to scholars chosen by examination, personal achievement folded into machinery that runs alone, the order not dying when the maker does. He proved that for a civilization's guardian in a foreign court, the strongest weapon is not morality but translation the other side cannot refuse.
civilization_zh: 13世纪蒙古帝国治下的汉地与草原——一个王朝崩解、征服与文明并存的欧亚世界
civilization_en: The Han lands and steppe under the Mongol empire of the 13th century — a Eurasian world of collapse, conquest and coexisting civilizations
roles_en: Institutional architect of the Mongol empire
Founder of the Yuan examination system
key_works: 十路课税所章程（制度，非书）
key_concepts: 马上得之不可马上治之

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与丘处机同在蒙古宫廷以'止杀'为业，路径互补成一对：丘处机以宗教领袖身份一次性进言（一言止杀），耶律楚材以文臣身份长期执行（把止杀做成课税与守令制度）；一个证明'一句话'能打开窗口，一个证明'一套制度'能把窗口变成门。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Qiu Chuji both made 'spare the slaughter' their trade in the Mongol court, on complementary paths: Qiu, as a religious patriarch, spoke once — the one word that stayed the killing; Chucai, as a civil minister, executed for years, making sparing an institution of tax offices and magistrates. One proved a single sentence can open the window; the other, that institutions can turn the window into a door.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与董仲舒同为'以一套学说为政权设计制度'的人，而接口相反：董仲舒向汉武帝提供天命-大一统的理论包装，使儒学成为帝国的官方语法；楚材向大汗提供岁入账目与历算服务，使儒法成为帝国的行政语法。两者共同证明：进入权力靠的从来不是学说本身，而是学说被需要的方式。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Dong Zhongshu both designed institutions for a regime through a body of doctrine, with opposite interfaces: Dongzhongshu offered Emperor Wu the theology of mandate and grand unity, making Confucianism the empire's official grammar; Chucai offered the khan revenue accounts and calendrical service, making Confucian law the empire's administrative grammar. Both prove entry to power comes never from doctrine itself but from the way doctrine is needed.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与迈蒙尼德同为'异族/动荡政权中的文明托命人'：迈蒙尼德在萨拉丁的埃及以医学侍苏丹而写成《迷途指津》，以希腊理性为犹太教辩护；楚材在蒙古宫廷以术数侍大汗而立课税选士之制，以汉法为中原文明续命。两人都证明：在征服者的屋檐下，专业知识是文明唯一的通行证。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Maimonides were both bearers of a civilization under an alien, turbulent power: Maimonides, physician to Saladin's sultan, wrote the Guide for the Perplexed, defending Judaism with Greek reason; Chucai, diviner to the Great Khan, built tax statutes and examinations, extending the life of Chinese civilization under the Mongols. Both proved that under the conqueror's roof, expert knowledge is the only passport a civilization holds.

cross_references.description_zh: 耶律楚材与马可·奥勒留同为'以哲学养成的权力内部人'而对象相反：奥勒留以斯多葛哲学约束自己行使的权力，写下沉思以自我审计；楚材以佛禅定力与儒家经世约束他人行使的权力，写下文簿法条以制度审计。一个向内修己，一个向外立法——共同揭示权力驯化的两条路：己与制。
cross_references.description_en: Yelü Chucai and Marcus Aurelius were both philosophers inside power, facing opposite objects: Aurelius used Stoic discipline to bind the power he himself wielded, writing meditations as self-audit; Chucai used Chan stillness and Confucian statecraft to bind the power others wielded, writing ledgers and statutes as institutional audit. One cultivated inward, the other legislated outward — the two roads of taming power: the self and the system.

modes.name_en: The Method of Arguing for Civilization's Survival
modes.domain_zh: 当征服者要把文明之地变成牧场时，不诉诸道德哀求，而把'保存文明'论证为征服者自身的利益：人口是税源、农业是财赋、士人是行政工具——让保护者角色成为权力自己算得过来的账
modes.domain_en: When the conqueror would turn civilized land into pasture, plead not morality but interest: population is the tax base, farming the revenue, scholars the instruments of rule — making the protector's role a ledger entry power itself can compute
modes.source_chapter: 窝阔台朝近臣别迭等倡言'汉人无补于国，可悉空其人以为牧地'，耶律楚材以'地税、商税、盐酒铁冶税岁可得银五十万两、帛八万匹、粟四十余万石'驳之，窝阔台乃命设十路课税所；1230年课税所征银如数而入，帝笑谓楚材'汝不去朕左右，而能使国用充足'
modes.key_quote_zh: 汉人无补于国之说谬矣——均定中原地税、商税、盐酒铁冶之课，岁可得银五十万两、帛八万匹、粟四十余万石，何谓无补？
modes.key_quote_en: 'The claim that the Han are of no use to the state is wrong: fix land, trade, salt, wine and iron taxes across the Central Plain and the year yields half a million taels of silver, eighty thousand bolts of silk, four hundred thousand shi of grain — how is that of no use?'
process_zh: 识别威胁的真正语言：征服者不听道德而听账目——先把对方反对的对象翻译成对方自己的损益
把文明的每一要素折算为可计量利益：人口折为税基，农田折为岁入，士人折为可用的行政与文书
以可验证的数字承诺对赌：给出确切税额并请设官试之，让事实证明而非雄辩证明
胜局后立即制度化：争得的不是一句宽免而是常设机构（十路课税所），使保护不再依赖任何一个人的在场
process_en: Identify the language your threatener actually speaks: the conqueror hears ledgers, not laments — translate the disputed object into the opponent's own profit and loss
Convert each element of civilization into countable interest: people as tax base, fields as revenue, scholars as usable administration
Stake the case on verifiable numbers: promise an exact sum and ask for offices to test it, letting facts argue instead of eloquence
Institutionalize the win at once: what is won is not a pardon but a standing office (the ten provincial tax commissions), so protection no longer depends on any one man's presence
representative_cases_zh: 反对'悉空汉地为牧场'之议：楚材不做道德檄文，而开出岁入账目——窝阔台依其数设十路课税所，次年银帛粟如数入库，汉地农耕文明免于废灭
以课税所得银当面试之：1231年帝于行在见所征银五十万两盈库，叹服'南国之臣复有如是人乎'——用可点验的成果让保护政策自证
争编修所、经籍所之设：不争空名而争机构，文献保存从'求情'变为'职掌'，这是把文明辩护做成国家职能的一步
representative_cases_en: Against the proposal to empty the Han lands for pasture, Yelü Chucai wrote no moral treatise but opened an account book: the khan set up ten tax commissions on his figures, and the next year silver, silk and grain flowed in to the mark — the agrarian civilization of North China was spared
He made the revenue a matter of test: in 1231 the khan saw half a million taels fill the treasury and marveled — verifiable results argued the policy better than any speech

He won the Institute of Compilation and the Office of Classics not as favors but as offices: preservation of texts passed from pleading to duty — defending civilization by making it a function of state
modern_applications_zh: 为'无用'的部门/文化项目争取预算：不写情怀陈述，而把它的存在折算为可量化收益并对赌考核
跨国并购与文化整合中的本地能力辩护：向总部证明本地团队是收入来源而非成本项
公共政策的利益化表达：把生态、文保等议题翻译为决策层惯用的财政与风险语言
modern_applications_en: Budget defense for an 'unprofitable' unit or cultural program: not a mission statement but a quantified benefit with a testable target
Defending local capability in a cross-border merger: prove to headquarters the local team is a revenue source, not a cost line
Translating public issues — ecology, heritage — into the fiscal and risk language the decision layer already speaks

modes.name_en: The Method of the Fixed Tax Statute
modes.domain_zh: 在掠夺式财政与包税盘剥之间立'定额可预期'的第三条路：以法定的地税商税取代军事劫掠与承包商放任，让被征服者交出确定税负换取可预期的生存，让征服者获得稳定岁入而非竭泽而渔
modes.domain_en: Between plunder finance and tax-farming, establish the third way of the fixed and predictable statute: legal land and trade taxes replace raiding and contractor license, so the conquered trade a certain burden for predictable survival and the conqueror gains steady revenue instead of draining the pond
modes.source_chapter: 1229-1230年劝窝阔台'勿以刀兵取财'，定中原地税（每亩二升？）、商税、盐酒铁冶课，设十路课税所征收；此后汉地'民始有更生之望'，蒙古财政由劫掠转向常制
modes.key_quote_zh: 以刀兵得天下者，不可以刀兵治之；供给之源，必在民力
modes.key_quote_en: 'He who won the world by the sword cannot govern it by the sword; the source of all supply lies in the strength of the people.'
process_zh: 诊断旧财政的结构性病灶：劫掠毁掉税源本身，包税放大盘剥——指出权力现在的方式正在自毁其收入
设计替代方案并给双方定价：给百姓确定税负（如地税若干升），给朝廷确定岁入（如银帛粟各若干），两边都可预期
设常设机构专职征收：十路课税所用文官账目取代武将劫掠，把财政从战利品变成制度
以足额兑现建立信用：第一年如数入库，此后增删皆依定制而非临时勒索——信用本身就是新的税源
process_en: Diagnose the structural disease of the old finance: raiding destroys the tax source itself, tax-farming magnifies extortion — show power that its present way is eating its own income
Price the replacement for both sides: a fixed burden for the people (so much grain per acre), a fixed yield for the court (so much silver, silk, grain) — both sides can plan
Create a standing office to collect: ten tax commissions run by civil accountants replace looting by generals — finance turns from spoils into institution
Build credit by delivering in full: the first year's haul matches the promise, and thereafter changes come by statute, not seizure — credit itself becomes the new tax base
representative_cases_zh: 以十路课税所取代诸王将校的任意征敛：蒙古对汉地的索取第一次有了定额与账册，'轻于旧制'而国用反足——减负与增收同时成立
1231年课税如期入库，窝阔台授楚材中书省印，使其掌管财赋与文簿：财政定制者由此取得相位级的执行权
临终犹力争'回收诸路冒占的官印纸币之权、抑买之弊'：定制不是一次性设计而是持续执法，直至身后权臣复以包税媚上，其制渐坏而汉地亦随之残破——定制之存废即民生之存废
representative_cases_en: The ten tax commissions replaced the arbitrary levies of princes and officers: the Mongol take from North China gained its first fixed rates and ledgers — lighter than the old exactions yet the treasury fuller, relief and revenue both true at once
When the 1231 revenue arrived on schedule, the khan gave Chucai the seal of the Secretariat: the designer of fiscal order thereby won execution power at ministerial rank

To the end he fought the seizure of the state's note-printing right and the abuses of forced purchase: a statute is not one design but continuous enforcement; when courtiers after his death flattered the khan with tax-farming again, the system decayed and the land with it — the statute's fate is the people's fate
modern_applications_zh: 初创公司从'抢单式收入'转向订阅/定额合同：可预期的现金流比单笔大单更养活组织
对冲突地区的援助设计：定额、可核查的转移支付优于不可持续的紧急输血
企业内部预算制度：用年度定额与账目透明替代部门间的政治博弈与突击花钱
modern_applications_en: A startup moving from deal-chasing to subscription and fixed contracts: predictable cash flow feeds an organization better than one big order
Aid design for conflict zones: fixed, verifiable transfers beat unsustainable emergency infusions
Corporate budgeting: annual fixed allocations and transparent accounts replace political bickering and year-end spending sprees

modes.name_en: The Method of Ruling by the Ledger
modes.domain_zh: 在口述传统与武力专断的帝国里，以户籍、账册、文书为治国基础设施：凡争皆验之于簿——把'谁的 remembered version 算数'变成'写下的数字算数'，用档案本身约束权力的一时之怒
modes.domain_en: In an empire of oral tradition and arbitrary force, build government on registers, accounts and documents: every dispute is checked against the book — the question shifts from whose memory counts to what is written counts, and the archive itself checks the ruler's momentary rage
modes.source_chapter: 楚材长期'权中书省'，主文书簿籍；立朝议制、行文簿考核；以册籍驳诸王冒请州县、以账目核军需冒领；《元史》称其'定策立仪制，讨残金之未附者，又以廉能课郡县'
modes.key_quote_zh: 天下虽得之马上，不可以马上治之——簿书期会之间，治道存焉
modes.key_quote_en: 'The world may be won from horseback but not ruled from horseback; the way of governance dwells in registers, ledgers and the season of reports.'
process_zh: 先把一切治理对象变成可记录对象：人户、田亩、仓廪、兵额皆入册——不可记录者即不可治理
凡争议必以簿证：诸王将校的口头请托与冒领，一律要求对册核查，让'谁说的'输给'写的什么'
以文书流转替代人盯人：政令、课税、考成皆循文书程限，权力的事务由记忆与忠诚转向程序与期限
把文簿传统传给继任者与后世：设编修所掌图籍，使档案成为可继承的国家资产而非一人私记
process_en: Turn every object of rule into a recordable object: households, acres, granaries, troop counts all enter the register — what cannot be recorded cannot be governed
Decide every dispute by the book: oral pleas and false claims of princes require checking against the registers — 'who said it' loses to 'what is written'
Replace personal supervision with paper in motion: edicts, taxes and evaluations move by documentary procedure and deadline — business of power shifts from memory and loyalty to process and schedule
Hand the tradition to successors: an Institute of Compilation keeps the archives as inheritable state property, not one man's private note
representative_cases_zh: 以户籍册驳'汉人无补'之议：楚材能即席开出岁入账目，正因人口田亩皆在册——档案完备是文明辩护的弹药库
诸王功臣冒请民户州县，楚材'皆验之以籍'逐一批驳：把分封的热情压回文书的格式里，保护了编户齐民
建编修所、经籍所于燕京：战火之余收金朝图籍文书，使一个王朝的记忆以档案而非传闻的方式进入下一个王朝
representative_cases_en: Against 'the Han are of no use', Chucai could open an account on the spot precisely because people and acres stood in registers — a complete archive is the ammunition depot of any defense of civilization

Princes and generals petitioned for whole districts; Chucai checked each against the books and rejected the false: the appetite for fiefdoms was pressed back into the formats of paperwork, shielding the registered commoners
He founded the Institute of Compilation and Office of Classics in Yanjing, gathering the documents of the fallen Jin: a dynasty's memory entered the next dynasty as archive, not rumor
modern_applications_zh: 组织制度化的第一步：先把关键业务数据化入系统，再谈流程与考核——没有档案的改革是空谈
与强势方的争议处理：所有口头承诺要求落成书面并归档，用记录约束权力关系
政府数字化/企业中台建设：把'不可记录'部门（人际、经验、隐性流程）显性化为可核查资产
modern_applications_en: The first step of institutionalization: get the core business data into a system before reforming process — reform without archives is talk
Handling disputes with the powerful: every oral promise written down and archived — records check power relations
Digital government and middle-platform builds: make the unrecordable — relationships, experience, tacit process — explicit, checkable assets
representative_figures: 耶律楚材（核心）
萧何（先行：入关先收图籍的档案立国传统）
刘晏（同构：以账簿与信息网络理财的唐代能手）
司马迁（参照：记录本身作为对抗遗忘的公共工程）
modes.definition_zh: 在口述传统与武力专断的帝国里，以户籍、账册、文书为治国基础设施：凡争皆验之于簿——把'谁的 remembered version 算数'变成'写下的数字算数'，用档案本身约束权力的一时之怒
modes.definition_en: In an empire of oral tradition and arbitrary force, build government on registers, accounts and documents: every dispute is checked against the book — the question shifts from whose memory counts to what is written counts, and the archive itself checks the ruler's momentary rage

modes.name_en: The Method of the Diviner's Lever
modes.domain_zh: 进言者与草原权力的接口不在经义而在术数：以占星、医药、历算为'入耳'的通道，把儒家的政治主张装载进大汗愿意听信的知识形式里——用对方的信任结构承载自己的道义内容
modes.domain_en: The interface to steppe power runs not through classics but through the arts of divination: astrology, medicine and calendrics are the channel into the khan's ear, loading Confucian statecraft into a form of knowledge the khan already trusts — carrying one's moral content in the other's trust structure
modes.source_chapter: 楚材以星象、医卜、历算侍成吉思汗，随征西域；'每征伐必命楚材卜之'；尝以'荧惑犯房'等天象与 '彗星见于西方'之占进言宽刑减赋；窝阔台尝执其手谓'非卿则中原无今日'
modes.key_quote_zh: 治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠？——术数其表，生民其里
modes.key_quote_en: 'Even a bow needs a bow-maker; shall the maker of the world do without a craftsman of the world? Divination is the shell — the living people are the core.'
key_concepts: 进入耳朵先于进入心灵
process_zh: 摸清权力实际信任什么：草原宫廷信天象、信占验、信实效——进言不从自己的专业出发，而从对方的信任结构出发
把政治主张装载进占验形式：减刑、缓杀、宽赋的主张以天象'示警'的面目出现，让权力顺从'天'而非顺从'人'
以医术、历算等实效服务累积言路资本：先做不可替代的专业侍从，再做敢言的政治顾问
待信任立住后逐步'去术存道'：从卜者升为国相，把从星象借来的话语权兑换成典章制度的制定权
process_en: Learn what power actually trusts: the steppe court trusts omens, the stars, results — begin not from your own discipline but from the other's trust structure
Load political claims into omen-form: clemency, halting slaughter, easing levies appear as warnings read in the heavens, so power obeys 'Heaven' rather than 'a man'
Bank speaking-rights through useful arts — medicine, calendrics: first become an indispensable professional retainer, then a counselor bold to speak
When trust stands, peel the shell from the core: rise from diviner to chancellor, exchange borrowed stellar authority for the making of statutes and rites
representative_cases_zh: 成吉思汗西征时以'冬雷骤发'之占劝止屠城之令：同一'止杀'主张，他人进言为忠谏，楚材进言为天意——形式差一线，成败差千里
以医术救治士卒、以占候选择行军时日：先在权力最关心的生死之事上证明有用，再谈生民之道
从'卜者'到'中书相'的转身：窝阔台朝典章制度多出其手——借术入门，最终以儒法立国，术数只是他递给草原的第一张名片
representative_cases_en: On the western campaign a 'thunder in winter' omen let him stay the order of massacre: the same plea to spare, from others a remonstrance, from Chucai Heaven's will — a hair of form, a world of outcome
Healing soldiers, timing marches by the stars: he proved useful first in the life-and-death matters power cares about, then spoke of the way of the people
The turn from 'diviner' to chancellor: much of Ögedei's statute-making came from his hand — the arts were his calling card to the steppe; the state he built was Confucian in frame
modern_applications_zh: 向只信数据的决策层进言：把价值主张做成对方信任的仪表盘与A/B测试，而非道德论述
跨国/跨专业沟通：用对方的行话与认证体系（财务、法务、临床）承载自己的主张
以'小事上的可靠'换取'大事上的发言权'：先在对方最关心的领域做到不可替代
modern_applications_en: Counseling a data-only leadership: cast your value claim as dashboards and A/B tests the decision layer trusts, not as moral essays
Cross-disciplinary and cross-cultural advocacy: carry your claim in the other side's jargon and credentials — finance, legal, clinical
Trade reliability in small things for voice in great ones: first be irreplaceable in what the powerful care about most
representative_figures: 耶律楚材（核心）
淳于髡（先行：以隐语入谏的接口传统）
邹衍（参照：五德终始说以术数入政）
基辛格（同构：以专业顾问身份进入并改造权力议程）

modes.name_en: The Method of Ordering Time by Calendar
modes.domain_zh: 为多重时间体系并存的帝国造一部正确的历法：修订《庚申元历》以统一正朔——以最技术的工作确立最政治的权威，让'何时为春分'这类事实裁决权成为文明话语权的支点
modes.domain_en: For an empire of many time-frames, make one correct calendar: revising the Gengshen-era calendar unifies the rightful season reckoning — the most technical work underwrites the most political authority, and the right to rule on 'when is the equinox' becomes the fulcrum of civilization's discourse
modes.source_chapter: 1216年起随成吉思汗,通天文历算;1220年代主持修订《庚申元历》(西征中于寻斯干城测影定历)，并进《西征庚午元历》；其历学上承《大明历》传统而参以西域实测
modes.key_quote_zh: 历者，纪也——正时所以正政
modes.key_quote_en: 'The calendar is the ledger of time: to order the seasons is to order governance.'
process_zh: 识别体系中的'时间乱源'：多历并行则政令失据、农时失序——把混乱本身呈现为权力的痛点
以实测修正旧历：在万里之外立表测影、记日月食验核，让修正建立在数据而非门派之争上
使新历成为政令的时间底座：课税起征、朝会吉日、文移程限皆系于官历——技术成果转化为制度基础设施
把历学传统留给后世：其历算之学与《西游录》所记西域实测资料，为后来郭守敬《授时历》之先声
process_en: Find the sources of temporal chaos: many calendars side by side leave edicts groundless and farming seasons astray — present the confusion as power's own pain
Correct the old calendar by measurement: gnomon shadows cast ten thousand li from home, eclipses logged for verification — revision grounded in data, not in schools' quarrels
Make the new calendar the time-base of governance: tax deadlines, assembly days, the term-limits of documents all hang on the official reckoning — technique becomes infrastructure
Leave the tradition behind: his calendrical work and the western measurements recorded in his Records of the Western Travel ran ahead of Guo Shoujing's Season-Granting Calendar
representative_cases_zh: 西征途中于寻斯干（撒马尔罕）以西域实测参订历法：中原历学与伊斯兰天文知识在其手中第一次系统互校
以《庚申元历》为行政程限之基：课税所的起征、文书程限皆依官历，财政制度与时间制度互为表里
以日月食之验核历之疏密：让'谁对'由天可验——在派系纷争的朝廷上，可复核的技术事实是最硬的通货
representative_cases_en: On campaign at Samarqand he revised the calendar with western measurements: Chinese calendrics and Islamic astronomy met in systematic cross-check for the first time in his hands
The Gengshen calendar became the time-base of administration: tax-start days and document deadlines all hung on the official reckoning — fiscal and temporal order made one
Eclipses tested the calendar's errors: 'who is right' was left to heaven to verify — in a court of factions, a checkable technical fact is the hardest currency
modern_applications_zh: 以标准化（协议、度量、接口）代替论战：把'谁说得对'变成'哪个标准可执行'
技术团队争取制度话语权：先做出全组织依赖的基础设施（如时间服务、数据字典），权威随之而来
跨时区跨国运营：统一的时间基准与日志是分布式组织治理的第一块基石
modern_applications_en: Replace polemics with standards — protocols, units, interfaces: turn 'who is right' into 'which standard runs'
Win institutional authority as a technologist: first build the infrastructure everyone depends on — time services, data dictionaries; authority follows
Multi-timezone operations: a unified time base and logs are the first cornerstone of distributed governance
representative_figures: 耶律楚材（核心）
郭守敬（后继：以《授时历》完成历法集大成）
一行（先行：以实测改历的唐代高僧）
祖冲之（参照：历算之争以验食为断的传统）

modes.definition_en: For an empire of many time-frames, make one correct calendar: revising the Gengshen-era calendar unifies the rightful season reckoning — the most technical work underwrites the most political authority, and the right to rule on 'when is the equinox' becomes the fulcrum of civilization's discourse

modes.name_en: The Method of the Dual Track: Rule Han by Han Ways
modes.domain_zh: 不在帝国强推单一制度，而为不同文明区设计双轨治理：汉地行汉法（编户、赋税、科举、守令），草原行草原法（分封、断事官）——让差异共存于一个可协调的框架，而非以征服者的方式抹平一切
modes.domain_en: Impose no single system on the empire: design dual-track governance, Han law for the Han lands (registers, taxes, examinations, magistrates), steppe law for the steppe (appanages, judges of the road) — let difference coexist in one coordinated frame instead of flattening all by the conqueror's way
modes.source_chapter: 楚材立朝仪、定课税、置守令、1237年奏请'以经义、词赋、论分为三科'开科取士，释放被俘为奴的儒士数千人；同时不废蒙古断事官与千户制，两制并行
modes.key_quote_zh: 马上得之，不可以马上治之——中原之地，当用中原之法
modes.key_quote_en: 'Won from horseback, it cannot be ruled from horseback: for the Central Land, the Central Land's own law.'
process_zh: 承认差异是治理前提而非敌人：不要求草原改宗汉法，也不让汉地被草原法撕碎
为汉地重建最小制度集：守令、户籍、赋税、学校——先恢复'可以治理'的骨架再谈教化
以科举与释奴打通人才通道：把沦为驱口的儒士赎出，令以三科取士，为政权选文官而非只选勇士
用财政与文书把两轨接通：课税所、文簿体系是双轨之上的'共同货币'，使并存不散架
process_en: Treat difference as premise, not enemy: ask the steppe to convert to Han law no more than you let steppe law tear the Han lands apart
Rebuild the minimal institution set for the Han lands: magistrates, registers, taxes, schools — restore the skeleton of governability before culture
Open talent channels by examination and manumission: ransom scholars held as slaves, examine in three subjects — recruit civil officials for the state, not only warriors
Join the two tracks with finance and paperwork: tax commissions and the ledger system are the common currency above both rails, keeping coexistence from falling apart
representative_cases_zh: 1237年'戊戌选试'取士四千余人：亡国之际的儒生第一次把'读书'重新变成进入政权的路径，元代文官制度由此发端
释放'驱口'儒士数千人并禁买卖：不靠空谈斯文，而是把'士'从财产名单里划出来——对文明的保护落在具体的人身上
在保留蒙古分封与断事官制的同时为汉地置守令课税：不求一致、只求接口——楚材体制是后来行省制的先声
representative_cases_en: The examination of 1237 selected over four thousand: in an age of conquest, scholarship became again a path into government — the seed of Yuan civil administration
He freed thousands of scholars held as slaves and banned the trade: not speeches about letters, but striking 'scholar' off the property lists — protection of civilization landing on actual persons
He kept Mongol appanage and road-judges while setting magistrates and tax offices for the Han lands: not uniformity but interfaces — the Chucai order prefigured the later provincial system
modern_applications_zh: 跨国/跨区域组织的治理设计：总部与本地各按其法运转，以共享的财务与数据系统接通
并购整合：不强推总部流程全盘替换，保留被并购方的高效局部，用接口层连接
多元团队管理：为不同专业文化设计各自的工作方式，以共同的度量与文档标准协调
modern_applications_en: Governance of multi-region organizations: headquarters and local units each run their own law, joined by shared finance and data systems
Post-merger integration: do not replace everything with headquarters process; keep the acquired side's effective parts and connect via an interface layer
Managing diverse teams: separate working styles per professional culture, coordinated by common metrics and documentation standards
representative_figures: 耶律楚材（核心）
忽必烈（后继：行汉法倾向的延伸与反复）
赵武灵王（先行：胡服骑射的双向采纳）
大英帝国印度文官制（同构：双轨治理的近代样本）

modes.name_en: The Method of Shielding Order Beside a Weak Throne
modes.domain_zh: 制度的存亡系于一人而其人将去时，以'周旋而非决裂'续命制度：对马皇后式的强宗、对奥都剌合蛮式的敛臣，不硬顶而死守底线，退而以署名权、程序权拖延恶政——一票否决做不到时，一票缓期也是否决
modes.domain_en: When an order's fate hangs on one man about to depart, extend its life by maneuvering, not breaking: before matriarchal clans and revenue-hawk ministers, do not die on every hill — retreat to the veto of signature and procedure, delaying the evil decree; when a full veto is impossible, a stayed veto still vetoes
modes.source_chapter: 窝阔台晚年信用奥都剌合蛮（扑买课税），楚材屡争不得；1241年窝阔台死后乃马真皇后称制，'事多不由中书'，楚材愤悒而于1244年卒，临卒犹以'先朝旧政'争课税与印钞之权
modes.key_quote_zh: 老臣但知守先帝之法，死生以之
modes.key_quote_en: 'This old minister knows only to keep the late emperor's laws — his life and death staked on them.'
process_zh: 分清可让与不可让：把恶政按危害排序，舍末端争要害（课税权、印钞权），不在每个阵地耗尽自己
以程序代替道德对抗：凡恶令必经中书签署、必循文簿——用流程环节给自己争取每一次'缓期'
以先帝之法为合法性来源：不诉诸己见而诉诸'旧制'，让对抗的旗帜是制度而非个人
预置身后之局：生前安排继承人与文档，使制度在自己之后仍有人与纸可依
process_en: Sort the concedable from the non-negotiable: rank the evil policies by harm, trade the periphery to defend the core — the power to tax and to print — without exhausting yourself on every front
Fight by procedure, not moral duel: every bad decree must pass the Secretariat's signature and the ledgers — each step of process buys one more delay
Draw legitimacy from the late emperor's statutes: appeal to 'the old system', not to yourself, so the banner of resistance is the institution, not the man
Set the after-scene in advance: arrange successors and papers so the order has hands and documents to lean on when you are gone
representative_cases_zh: 奥都剌合蛮以重额扑买课税媚上，楚材'力辨其不可'而不得，转而坚守中书签署之权：令不出中书则行之愈难——每个环节的迟滞都是民间的喘息
乃马真称制后诏旨多出，楚材仍据'先帝旧制'驳之，愤悒而卒：他证明了弱主之世制度家能撑多久不取决于勇气而取决于程序上有多少道门
临终遗言'恐甲午后课税、印钞之事'仍嘱以旧制：把最后的力气花在文件上而非遗恨上——制度家的遗嘱是章程
representative_cases_en: When Abd al-Rahman bid huge sums to farm the taxes and flattered the khan, Chucai argued him down without success — then held the Secretariat's right of signature: a decree that cannot leave the chancellery is harder to execute, and every held step was a breath for the people

Under Empress Töregene's regency edicts flowed from elsewhere; Chucai kept rejecting them by 'the late emperor's statutes' and died worn down: he proved that in a weak-throne age, how long an institutionalist lasts depends not on courage but on how many doors procedure has

On his deathbed his last words concerned the tax farms and the note-press, commending them to the old statutes: his final strength went into documents, not into grief — an institutionalist's testament is a charter
modern_applications_zh: 职业经理人面对董事会错误决策：以合规、审计、签署权等程序节点拖延并留痕，而非以辞职相搏
公共机构负责人在政治压力下：按危害排序守住核心职能，末端让步换取要害存续
开源/社区维护者对抗商业化侵蚀：以许可证与治理章程为'先帝之法'，守住签署与分发权
modern_applications_en: A professional manager facing a board's bad call: delay and leave records at compliance, audit, signature nodes rather than gamble all on resignation
A public-agency head under political pressure: rank by harm, guard core functions, trade the periphery for the core's survival
Open-source maintainers against commercial capture: license and governance charter as the 'late emperor's statutes' — hold the signing and distribution keys

modes.name_en: The Method of the Buddhist Bone, Confucian Heart
modes.domain_zh: 不选择身份而综合身份：楚材出契丹皇族、学佛于万松、行儒于中书——以'忘缘息虑'的禅定功夫养定力，以儒家的经世之志定方向，以'湛然居士'的自号自守士人风骨——多重传统在一人身上成为互补而非分裂
modes.domain_en: Choose no single identity but synthesize: born of Khitan royalty, schooled in Chan Buddhism by Wan-song, serving as Confucian in the Secretariat — Chan stillness trains composure, Confucian statecraft sets direction, the sobriquet 'Juran Layman' guards the scholar's spine; many traditions as complement, not fracture
modes.source_chapter: 师事万松行秀参禅三年，'忘缘息虑'自誓不杂一言；自号'湛然居士'；著《湛然居士文集》十四卷，《西游录》上卷记西行见闻、下卷批驳全真之专横——以佛门立场卫儒政而不失僧格
modes.key_quote_zh: 以儒治国，以佛治心——二者如车之两轮，缺一不可
modes.key_quote_en: 'Govern the state by Confucian way, govern the heart by the Buddha's: the two are the wheels of one cart, neither dispensable.'
process_zh: 把各传统归位：分清何者为'心法'（禅）、何者为'治法'（儒）、何者为'根脉'（家世）——不混用也不偏废
以修行功夫直接滋养政治品质：参禅所得的定力与不诳语，转化为朝堂上的沉着与言而有信
在冲突场合亮明立场而非骑墙：《西游录》下卷痛斥全真侵佛寺、毁佛像——为儒政效力不等于对谁事都和稀泥
以文字自持：《湛然居士文集》记录心迹与交游，让身份整合留下可查的自我叙述
process_en: Assign each tradition its place: distinguish the 'way of the heart' (Chan), the 'way of rule' (Confucian), the 'root' (lineage) — neither blended into mush nor any one discarded
Let cultivation feed politics directly: the composure and truthfulness won in Chan become poise in court and a word that holds

Show the stance in conflict, not a middle path for its own sake: the second part of the Records of the Western Travel lashes the Quanzhen seizure of monasteries — serving a Confucian state is no license to blur everything
Hold identity in writing: the Collected Works of the Juran Layman record the heart's course and friendships — an integration with a checkable self-narrative
representative_cases_zh: 从万松参禅'忘缘息虑'，后于军书旁午中从容应对：定力是练出来的政治资本，而非天赋性格
以'湛然居士'自号并终生称之：身在宰相之位而以居士自持——身份的重心放在精神传统而非官爵
《西游录》下卷与全真教之争：既借丘处机一系护过汉民，又在佛寺被毁时直言相击——保护对象是文明整体而非某一教门
representative_cases_en: Chan practice under Wan-song, 'forgetting conditions and stilling thoughts', bore fruit amid the paperwork of campaigns: composure is trained political capital, not temperament
He styled himself 'Juran Layman' his whole life: a chancellor who kept a layman's self-address — the center of identity in a spiritual tradition, not in rank

The quarrel with the Quanzhen school in his Records: he had benefited from their protection of the Han, yet struck straight when monasteries fell — what he shielded was civilization whole, no single school
modern_applications_zh: 多元职业身份的整合（工程师+管理者+写作者）：给每个身份明确分工与守护边界，而非硬选其一
以个人修行/锻炼习惯滋养领导力：定力、诚实是可训练的专业资产
在合作方之间保持立场清晰：曾受益的关系不等于放弃批评权——'护整体不护门派'
modern_applications_en: Integrating plural professional identities — engineer, manager, writer: give each a defined share and a guarded boundary rather than a forced single choice
Feed leadership from personal practice: composure and honesty are trainable professional assets
Keep positions clear among partners: a relationship that once helped you does not forfeit your right to criticize — protect the whole, not the sect

王维（参照：亦官亦隐的居士传统）
苏轼（同构：儒释道互补的人格范式）
木心（现代：多重身份自我叙述的写作者）

modes.name_en: The Method of Counseling by the Fault of the Ruler
modes.domain_zh: 进言不动刀兵而动权力的自我叙事：把'止杀'论证为大汗身后的名声与天下归心的前提——'罪己'则民心附、嗜杀则四方叛，让仁政成为征服者自我形象的工程，而非外人强加的枷锁
modes.domain_en: Counsel not by force but by the ruler's own self-narrative: frame 'spare the killing' as the precondition of his name after death and the world's turning to him — self-blame wins hearts, delight in slaughter breeds revolt, so benevolent rule becomes the conqueror's own image project, not a shackle outsiders impose
modes.source_chapter: 随成吉思汗西征与窝阔台南伐，屡以'天壤之间,生民之众,莫不欲安'进言；劝止自行州郡屠城之令；窝阔台南征时谏止'平民屠戮'，并以'猫捕鼠、犬守家'喻各安其分
modes.key_quote_zh: 兴一善念则四海安，兴一恶念则生民涂炭——愿陛下忍一时之忿，垂万世之名
modes.key_quote_en: 'One good thought and the four seas rest; one evil thought and the living drown: suffer, Your Majesty, an hour's anger, and leave a name for ten thousand generations.'
process_zh: 找到权力的软肋不在军力而在叙事：征服者最深的恐惧是身后骂名与四方不附
把仁政写入对方的自我形象：'不嗜杀人者能一之'——止杀不是对大汗的约束，而是对'天命所归'的证明
以具体指令代替抽象训诫：请求的具体到'某城勿屠、某户勿掠'，让原则在每个决策点被即时兑现
在权力胜利时进言：胜势之中纳谏成本低——把谏言安排在权力最自信的时刻
process_en: Locate where power is soft — not in armies but in narrative: the conqueror's deepest fear is an cursed name and a world that will not attach
Write benevolence into his self-image: 'he who delights not in killing unifies all' — sparing slaughter is no constraint on the khan but proof of Heaven's mandate
Prefer concrete instructions to abstract preaching: the request runs to 'spare this city, take not that quarter', so the principle is cashed at each decision point
Counsel at the hour of victory: in the flow of success the cost of listening is low — schedule remonstrance for power's most confident moment
representative_cases_zh: 西征中劝止屠城之令：以'围而降者免死'反复申之，史载所活不可胜计——谏言落成具体的免死令而非泛泛的仁论
对窝阔台以'猫捕鼠、犬守家'喻职分：用草原听得懂的比喻重述儒家秩序观——修辞的形式为听者定制
'千秋万世徒闻其名，一日之遇垂之无穷'：把进言与身后的名声直接挂钩，让权力为'名'买单
representative_cases_en: On the western march he pressed 'spare the surrendered' again and again until standing orders spared the cities that yielded — history counts the living beyond number: the counsel landed as concrete orders of clemency, not general essays on mercy
Before Ögedei he used 'the cat catches mice, the dog guards the house' to teach each his office: Confucian order retold in a metaphor the steppe understood — rhetoric tailored to the listener
'A thousand autumns may hear the name only; one day's meeting endures forever': he tied counsel directly to the name after death — power pays for 'renown'
modern_applications_zh: 对强势利益相关方的劝服：把你要的主张写成对方的'遗产'与'形象'，而非自己的诉求
公共倡导的修辞设计：为目标受众定制比喻与场景，把抽象价值翻译为其母语
在组织高光时刻提出改革：趁着资源与自信最充裕时提最难的建议
modern_applications_en: Persuading powerful stakeholders: write your claim as their legacy and image, not your demand
Rhetoric design for public advocacy: tailor metaphor and scene to the audience's mother tongue, translating abstract values
Raise reform at the organization's high moment: ask for the hardest change when confidence and resources peak

孟子（思想源头：'不嗜杀人者能一之'）
魏征（先行：以名节杠杆驱动君主的谏诤传统）
格林斯潘式顾问（对照：以专业话语进入权力议程的现代形态）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Order That Outlives Its Maker
modes.domain_zh: 制度家最大的风险是'人亡政息'：生前即把每一项保护都写成法条、置于常设机构、交予指定之人，并让对手能检验自己——使个人功业折叠进可独立运转的制度，人去而政不自息
modes.domain_en: The institutionalist's greatest risk is that the man leaves and the order dies: write every protection into statute while alive, lodge it in standing offices, hand it to named successors, and let rivals inspect it — fold personal achievement into a mechanism that runs alone, so the order does not stop when the maker does
modes.source_chapter: 生前定课税所、编修所、经籍所之制；戊戌选试取士为元代科举立基；《元史》载其'以所用必得人'；1244年卒后乃马真氏乱政，其制屡遭破坏而其门下士与文簿犹存，元世祖朝汉法派复起多祖述楚材
modes.key_quote_zh: 老臣一生所守，非为一身之计，乃为万世之规
modes.key_quote_en: 'What this old minister has kept all his life was never for one man's sake but for the rule of ten thousand generations.'
process_zh: 把每一项口头获得的保护即刻成文：宽免、定制、机构皆落纸并归档——'写下来的才活得过你'
为制度设官不设人：课税所以官吏任之，不以私属任之——职位高于关系
提前选拔与历练继承梯队：以科举与编修所养士，让制度有自己的知识谱系
以对手与后世的检验为设计标准：每项安排都假设最强反对者来审查——经得起翻案的制度才算立住
process_en: Write every orally won protection into text at once: remissions, statutes, offices all on paper and archived — only the written outlives you
Set offices, not persons: tax commissions staffed by officers, not by personal clients — the post above the tie
Raise the succession cohort early: examinations and the Institute of Compilation cultivate scholars, giving the order its own intellectual lineage
Design for the hostile audit: assume the strongest opponent will review every arrangement — only what survives overturning stands
representative_cases_zh: 课税所与戊戌选试在其身后仍被援引：乃马真氏虽毁其政，但文书俱在、先例已成，忽必烈朝恢复汉法时直接接续楚材之制
置编修所收金朝图籍：文明档案以国家机构形式传承，个人不再唯一持有'知识记忆'
其文集与《西游录》本身就是设计：把心迹、政见、见闻全部成文——留给后世的不仅有制度还有可复述的方法
representative_cases_en: The tax commissions and the examination of 1238 were still cited after his death: though the regency wrecked his policies, the papers stood and the precedent held — when Qubilai's court revived Han law, it picked up Chucai's system where he left it
The Institute of Compilation kept the Jin archives: civilization's memory passed as a state organ, no longer held by one man alone
His Collected Works and Records are themselves design: heart's course, statecraft and observation all in writing — what he left was not only institutions but a method that can be retold
modern_applications_zh: 创始人退场设计：把'只有我懂的东西'文档化、流程化，让公司在没有你时照常运转
公共项目移交：不交付给个人而交付给机构与手册，附可验证的运行记录
个人知识遗产管理：以写作与开源让方法可被复述，胜过一切口头传授
modern_applications_en: Founder exit design: document and proceduralize what 'only I know', so the company runs without you
Handover of public projects: deliver to institutions and manuals with verifiable run logs, not to persons
Managing one's knowledge legacy: writing and open-source make the method retellable — beyond all oral transmission
